Campus Connect Agents Registry

This file lists available custom agents for Campus Connect and describes when to use them.

- Navigator Agent: `navigator.agent.md` — Project discovery, status, and docs lookup
- Developer Workflow Agent: `developer-workflow.agent.md` — Onboarding and dev environment checks
- Implementation Assistant Agent: `implementation-assistant.agent.md` — Scaffolding API endpoints and data-layer migrations
- QA & Verification Agent: `qa-verification.agent.md` — Running integration and smoke tests, CI readiness

If you add new agents, update this registry so team members can find them.
